title: The Long Way Around
setup: Black's king has just planted itself in front of the pawns, and neither pawn can move again.
hint: The pawn on b6 covers a5 and c5, so ask which side of the board the white king is still allowed to use.
explanation:
## The Idea

The pawn on b6 guards a5 and c5, so the white king can never come up beside its own pawn. {{Kd4}} begins the march through the center: {{Kc7}} {{Ke5}} {{Kd7}} {{Kd5}} and White wins the squares d5, e6 and d7 in turn, then walks to c6 and takes on b6.
